description:
Talents Kids is the premiere way to discover and cultivate your child's innate potential. By transforming everyday artifacts—like drawings, writings, and school projects—into deep talent insights, we help parents and educators understand exactly where a child shines. 

Our platform doesn't just analyze; it acts, generating personalized educational worksheets and creative coloring pages that turn talent discovery into a daily learning adventure. Whether you are tracking progress through earned achievements or exporting comprehensive talent reports, Talents Kids provides the tools you need to support your child's unique journey from the palm of your hand.

defaultPrompt: Show my child’s recent analysis history and strongest overall talents.
